Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.,Nagesh Kumar
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
1.

Heard Sri Deepak Kumar Jaiswal, learned counsel for the petitioner, learned Standing Counsel for the State-respondents no.1 and 4 and Sri Nagesh Kumar for the respondents no.2 and 3.
2.

The instant petition has been filed praying for a writ of mandamus commanding the respondents to pay compensation to the petitioner for having forcibly acquired 0.539 hectare land from Gata No.519M Khata No.00017 situated in revenue Village Karari, Tehsil and District Jhansi as per provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and decide the representation of the petitioner dated 31.10.2023.

sentences.text: 3. The Development Authority has submitted the written instructions.
The same is taken on record.
A copy thereof has also been provided to the learned counsel for the petitioner.
According to it, the road has been constructed after demarcation by a joint team constituted for the said purpose.
The subject land of the petitioner has not been included in the construction of the road.
4. Counsel for the petitioner tried to contend that the stand of the respondents is not correct.
In other words, he is disputing the correctness of the alleged survey carried out by the respondents.

5. We are of the opinion that the issues sought to be raised before this Court would entail a factual inquiry, which we are not inclined to carry out in exercise of writ jurisdiction.
6.

We, accordingly, dispose of the instant petition with liberty to the petitioner to get his holding demarcated under Section 24 of U.P. Revenue Code, 2006 or avail such other remedy, as may be advised.

Order Date :- 10.4.2024 AKShukla/-
(Kshitij Shailendra, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.)
